skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical development of economic theories and their impact on economic practices.
Analyze and evaluate different economic theories and their applications.
Conduct independent research on economic theories and their historical contexts.
Effectively communicate economic theories and their implications.
Apply economic theories to solve practical economic problems.
Understand the historical context of economic theories.
Master the core theories of economics from different schools of thought.
Analyze economic data and trends using historical economic theories.
Understand and evaluate economic policies based on historical theories.
Analyze the role of economic theories in development and growth.
